name: South Sound Solar, Inc.
old_description: Expertly designed solar energy solutions, tailored for your comfort and sustainability.
about:
South Sound Solar, Inc. has operated from Olympia, Washington since its founding in 2007. The company serves the South Sound region as a full-service solar and energy storage installer.

The firm functions as an electrical and general contractor, providing system design, installation, and ongoing service for residential and commercial photovoltaic arrays, battery backup systems, and electric vehicle charging stations. Its scope includes site assessment using professional shade analysis tools, custom proposal development, array repair, panel cleaning, and troubleshooting for monitoring systems, including equipment originally installed by other providers.

Customers range from homeowners seeking to reduce electricity costs to commercial property owners pursuing sustainability goals. The company regularly coordinates with Puget Sound Energy's solar calculator program and serves clients throughout Thurston County and the broader Pacific Northwest.

South Sound Solar emphasizes a single-point-of-responsibility model, handling design, installation, and long-term maintenance in-house. It offers free site surveys and aims to present options without sales pressure, positioning itself as a local resource for both new projects and orphaned systems.
